name: Pradyumna Mahajan
tagline: I build production web and mobile apps — from cross-platform React Native releases to Django and Laravel backends.
bio: I'm a full stack developer at DeccanLogic, Pune, where I'm a core developer on a cross-platform investor application — I built the React Native app from project start through to Play Store and TestFlight release, on a shared codebase with the web product. Alongside my full-time role I take on freelance work: a drone monitoring and control dashboard for IIT Roorkee using React.js, Django and LoRaWAN, and web platforms for IBN Group with Next.js and Laravel. I care about performance and architecture — lazy loading, render optimisation, and reusable component libraries are defaults for me, not afterthoughts.
